# YXZ Landscaping & Hardscaping

> Interlock repair, installation, power washing, polymeric sanding, and sealing for driveways, walkways, and patios across the Greater Toronto Area.

YXZ Landscaping & Hardscaping is a hardscaping contractor based in Woodbridge, Ontario, serving Toronto, Vaughan, Mississauga, Brampton, Richmond Hill, Markham, and surrounding GTA communities. Core work: interlock restoration (pressure washing, polymeric sand replacement, sealing in 1 or 2 coats), interlock repair and releveling, new interlock installation, retaining walls, excavation, and backyard renovations. Free quotes answered within 24 hours.

## Business details (NAP)
